headline: Pickaxe Mountain named as possible target

sources: Donald Trump, phone interview with C-SPAN's Washington Journal Primetime, Monday night Nov 9, 2026
fault_line: Bluff or real capability: can the US actually deliver a strike 'five times bigger', and what would Iran do back -- vs Trump's own hold-off because five Gulf states asked him to stop.

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- the 'five times bigger' warning] Trump said a renewed US attack on Iran could be 'approximately five times bigger than the first hit, which basically decimated them', but that he is holding off at the request of Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain and Kuwait, who 'would rather do it this way'. He said 'We won Venezuela, and we won Iran. We wiped out their Navy, we wiped out their Air Force, we wiped out everything'; Iran 'would like to make a deal'; the US 'could knock it out fast'. He also raised Pickaxe Mountain, saying the US may have to strike it if Iran does something there, but does not see that now. He said the US is watching Iran's nuclear sites and cannot let Iran have a nuclear weapon.
sections.what_verified: Quote confirmed across multiple families; the underlying claims ('won Iran', 'Iran wants a deal') are Trump's assertions, not verified facts.
sections.what_disputed: (a) SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei (0800-02): 'FAKE NEWS about imaginary talks', tells Trump to 'SURRENDER to the seven conditions' -- directly contradicts 'Iran wants a deal'. (b) Qatari PM Al Thani's own public account of the Nov 9 White House meeting made NO mention of supporting the continued US naval blockade (Times Now liveblog 05:10 IST entry) -- Trump's claim that all five Gulf states prefer the status quo including the blockade is unconfirmed by the Gulf states themselves. (c) 'We won Iran' vs the war continuing: US struck Qeshm Island Nov 8 (Iranian state media/Fars) and Ansar Allah attacks on Saudi Arabia continued into Nov 10. (d) No basis given for 'five times bigger' -- no force package, no target list disclosed.
sections.why_matters: Trump says the next hit would be five times bigger -- while telling the Gulf states he is holding off because they asked. The threat and the hold-off in the same breath, plus a named target: Pickaxe Mountain.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP / IN-WINDOW PUBLICATION -- Trump: renewed US attack on Iran 'could be five times bigger'; Gulf states prefer hold-off; Pickaxe Mountain named as possible target

totw_analysis: Our read: Trump says the next hit would be five times bigger -- while telling the Gulf states he is holding off because they asked. The threat and the hold-off in the same breath, plus a named target: Pickaxe Mountain. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Bluff or real capability: can the US actually deliver a strike 'five times bigger', and what would Iran do back -- vs Trump's own hold-off because five Gulf states asked him to stop.
